## The POLISHED Process (How We Work)

1. Discovery & Strategy: Deep dive into the brand's market positioning and consumer psychology.

2. Visual Architecture: Crafting the quiet-luxury identity, typography, and color systems.

3. Execution & Launch: Delivering high-converting storefront UI assets and shelf-ready packaging.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- Q: What makes POLISHED different from regular agencies?

  A: We don't just design; we engineer premium perceptions. We exclusively build "Premium Bengali" identities for skincare e-commerce, combining local resonance with world-class luxury.

- Q: Do you take on every project?

  A: No. We work exclusively with brands that understand the value of long-term visual authority and are willing to invest in bespoke solutions.

- Q: What is the typical project timeline?

  A: Comprehensive brand identity systems take between 3 to 6 weeks, depending on the scope of the storefront and packaging needs.
